QUOTE: Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` in your `mbedtls_config.h`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY must be set to enable the facility, but it never says the option is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h.
